name: type1-south-west-to-geojson
source: values chosen for this vector (as type1-south-west-position)
reference: Negative coordinates. geojson writes coordinates [lon, lat], properties in field-line order (callsign, course, speed_ms), then id (ruling 4 of 0.1.1); uid is derived as text_of(ais.mmsi) (model/ais.def), so it is checked with @complete.
